sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 8459 of 2025

Petitioner :- Rajesh Bahadur Singh
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Yogesh Narayan Dubey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed with prayer to direct the court concerned to expedite the Session Trial No. 58 of 2021 (State vs. Vikas) arising out Case Crime No. 892 of 2020, under Section 498A, 304 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Soraon, District Prayagraj, pending in the court of Learned Additional District Judge- Ist,
Prayagraj, within stipulated time.

entities.text: Session Trial No. 58 of 2021 (State vs. Vikas)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the matter is pending consideration before the court concerned.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.
Rajesh Bahadur Singh vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 5 August, 2025

entities.text: Rajesh Bahadur Singh vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for petitioner, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of finally.
